faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Brokerage: 1.5 rents at signing. Monthly management: 10% of rent. No hidden costs.
faq.q2: What happens if the tenant doesn't pay?
faq.a2: You're covered. Our default insurance guarantees up to 12 months + damages.
faq.q3: Can I leave whenever I want?
faq.q4: Do you operate in Spain as well?
faq.a4: Yes. We operate throughout Portugal and Spain.
faq.q5: How long does it take to rent out?
faq.a5: Average 18 business days from valuation to signed contract.
faq.a6: Through our included default insurance. If the tenant fails, WEKASAS activates the coverage and you continue to receive your rent monthly for up to 12 months.
faq.q7: Do I have to pay for photos?
faq.a7: No. Professional photo report is included at no additional cost in both Brokerage and Full Management plans.

about_page.hero_title: We created WEKASAS to end uncertainty.
about_page.hero_sub: Rent management focusing on predictability, simplicity and security.
about_page.manifesto_text:
Renting out a property should be simple. It's not.
There's the tenant who delays. The one who damages. The one who disappears.
There's the bureaucracy, the contracts, the inspections, the calls no one answers.
And at the end of the month, the uncertainty.
We created WEKASAS to end that.
We treat your property as if it were ours.
We find the right tenant. We manage everything.
And we guarantee your rent — every month, without exception.
about_page.mission_text: To make renting simple, safe and fair — for landlords and tenants.
